en-AU.promotionalText: On-device Photos storage consultant — find reclaimable space and clean up safely.
en-AU.description:
DiskWise for iPhone and iPad is an on-device Photos storage consultant. It scans your photo library, estimates reclaimable space, and helps you move clutter to Recently Deleted — never permanent delete in v1.

WHAT IT DOES
• Find exact duplicates and similar media
• Surface screenshots, bursts, large videos, and older items
• Ranked recommendations with reclaimable estimates
• Preview and confirm before anything is removed

SAFE CLEANUP
Selected items go to Photos → Recently Deleted so you can recover them for about 30 days. DiskWise never empties Recently Deleted.

PRIVACY
All analysis runs on your device. Photo contents are not uploaded to a cloud service.

Learn more at https://diskwise.suherman.net

review.notes:
RESPONSE TO APP REVIEW — Guideline 2.3.3 Accurate Metadata (13-inch iPad screenshots)

We replaced all 13-inch iPad (and iPhone) screenshots with fresh captures from the current 1.0 build. Each frame shows live DiskWise UI in use:
1. Dashboard — reclaimable estimate, ranked recommendations, cleanup buckets
2. Large Videos recommendation detail — select reclaimable videos
3. Screenshots bucket — multi-select cleanup candidates
4. Confirm cleanup — Move to Recently Deleted preview (never permanent delete)

Screenshots were recaptured on a clean App Store iPad Pro 13 simulator after erasing leftover system sheets from other apps. Duplicate/identical frames were removed.

HOW TO REVIEW
1. Tap Continue on the Photos explanation screen, then choose access (Full Access recommended; Limited works).
2. Wait for the library scan — dashboard shows reclaimable space and buckets.
3. Open a recommendation/bucket → select items → Review → Move to Recently Deleted.
4. Confirm items appear in Photos → Recently Deleted.

No login. Analysis is on-device. DiskWise does not use Location Services.
